react-dialog/library/src/utils/useDisabl: Scroll-lock classes applied to html and body, not a rendered component, so the harness does not sample it. The class lookup is covered by react-dialog/library/src/utils/useDisableBodyScroll.styles.css.test.ts.
react-drawer/library/src/shared/useDrawe: Shared base styles used by useOverlayDrawerStyles and useInlineDrawerStyles, whose Griffel baselines resolve the Griffel helper (cypress.config.ts .styles.ts rule); compared through Overlays.cy.tsx.
react-nav/library/src/components/sharedN: Shared nav styles used by AppItem, AppItemStatic, Hamburger, NavCategoryItem, NavDrawer, NavItem, NavSubItem and SplitNavItem, whose Griffel baselines resolve the Griffel helper (cypress.config.ts .styles.ts rule); compared through Navigation.cy.tsx.
react-portal/library/src/components/Port: GAP: no parity spec yet. The class comes from usePortalMountNode, which Portal.tsx and every overlay call through react-portal's own modules, so a Griffel baseline needs react-portal re-instantiated with its Griffel module (the griffelPackages helper in FeedbackAndCompat.cy.tsx). The styled node is created in the document body (or the PortalMountNodeProvider node) and is skipped when a mountNode element is passed, so it is always outside the parity containers that ComponentSpec.findRoot searches.
react-positioning/library/src/hooks/useS: GAP: no parity spec yet. SafeZoneArea renders only inside an open Menu with a submenu, and its wrapper and svg styles switch (display none to block) while the pointer moves from the trigger towards the submenu, which the harness states (rest, hover, pressed, focus) do not drive. SafeZoneArea.tsx imports './SafeZoneArea.styles' itself, so a Griffel baseline also needs react-positioning re-instantiated (griffelPackages in FeedbackAndCompat.cy.tsx).
